text: Abanca Corporacion Bancaria, S.A. is controlled by Juan Carlos Escotet Rodriguez, who is the bank's effective owner (titular efectivo) with 84.75% of the share capital: 43.50% held directly and 41.25% indirectly through the Spanish company Escotet Family Office S.L.U. Abanca's annual corporate-governance report states there are no other shareholders above 5%. No state or fund capital is reported.
short: Abanca is controlled by Juan Carlos Escotet Rodriguez with 84.75% of the share capital.

source.name: Abanca, Memoria Anual de Gobierno Corporativo 2025
source.quote: Juan Carlos Escotet Rodríguez es el titular efectivo de la Sociedad, con una participación del 84,75% del capital social: 43,50% de propiedad directa y 41,25% de propiedad indirecta a través de la sociedad española
